$comment: Coverage for every remaining table: what it holds, its grain, and how to join it. Columns are deliberately limited to the ones needed to join and identify a row — these tables are wide and listing recalled column names would be guessing. columns_complete is false throughout; run tools/verify_against_sigma.py to fill them in from a real account.

application_fees.description: Fees your Connect platform collected from connected accounts.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Fee amount in minor currency units.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Connected account the fee was collected from.

columns.name: refunded
columns.description: Whether the fee was fully refunded.

application_fee_refunds.description: Refunds of application fees back to connected accounts.
application_fee_refunds.grain: One row per application fee refund.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Refunded amount in minor currency units.

payment_methods.description: Saved payment instruments attached to customers.

columns.name: created
columns.description: When the payment method was created (UTC).

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer the method is attached to.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Payment method family, e.g. card, us_bank_account, sepa_debit.

setup_intents.description: Attempts to save a payment method for future use without charging it immediately.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer the method is being saved for.

setup_attempts.description: Individual attempts to confirm a SetupIntent, including failures.
setup_attempts.grain: One row per setup attempt. A SetupIntent can have several.

sources.description: Legacy payment sources, superseded by payment_methods. Present for older integrations.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier, prefixed src_ (or card_ for legacy cards).

notes: Prefer payment_methods for anything built after the Sources API was deprecated.

payment_reviews.description: Payments flagged by Radar for manual review, and how they were resolved.

columns.name: closed_reason
columns.description: How the review was resolved, e.g. approved, refunded, disputed.

payment_records.description: Unified payment records spanning Stripe and externally processed payments.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the payment record.

connected_account_payment_records.description: Connect platform view of payment_records for connected accounts.
connected_account_payment_records.grain: One row per payment record, per connected account.

disputes_enhanced_eligibility.description: Eligibility of each dispute for enhanced evidence programs such as Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0.

card_testing.description: Radar signals about suspected card testing activity on your account.
card_testing.grain: One row per detected card testing event or aggregate window.

radar_data_integration.description: Custom data you have sent to Radar for use in rules, joined back to the payments it scored.
radar_data_integration.grain: One row per submitted data point.

checkout_sessions.description: Stripe Checkout sessions, including abandoned ones. The table to use for hosted-checkout conversion analysis.

columns.name: payment_link_id
columns.description: Payment link that opened the session.

columns.name: amount_total
columns.description: Total amount in minor currency units.

notes: status = 'expired' identifies abandoned checkouts — the denominator for conversion rate.

checkout_line_items.description: Line items on a Checkout session.
checkout_line_items.grain: One row per line item on a session.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the line item.

columns.name: amount_total
columns.description: Line total in minor currency units.

checkout_custom_fields.description: Values customers entered into custom fields you configured on a Checkout session.

payment_links.description: Reusable shareable links that open a Checkout session.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the link still accepts payments.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Public URL of the payment link.

credit_notes.description: Post-issuance adjustments to invoices — the correct way to represent refunds and write-offs against a finalized invoice.

columns.name: created
columns.description: When the credit note was issued (UTC).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Credited amount in minor currency units.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the credit note was issued.

credit_note_line_items.description: Line items on a credit note.
credit_note_line_items.grain: One row per credit note line item.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the line item.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Line amount in minor currency units.

credit_note_tax_amounts.description: Tax amounts applied at the credit note level.
credit_note_tax_amounts.grain: One row per (credit note, tax rate).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Tax amount in minor currency units.

credit_note_line_item_tax_amounts.description: Tax amounts applied to individual credit note line items.
credit_note_line_item_tax_amounts.grain: One row per (credit note line item, tax rate).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Tax amount in minor currency units.

credit_note_discount_amounts.description: Discount amounts applied at the credit note level.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Discount amount in minor currency units.

credit_note_line_item_discount_amounts.description: Discount amounts applied to individual credit note line items.
credit_note_line_item_discount_amounts.grain: One row per (credit note line item, discount).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Discount amount in minor currency units.

invoice_items.description: One-off charges or credits queued onto a customer's next invoice.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer the item will be billed to.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice the item landed on, once invoiced.

columns.name: subscription_id
columns.description: Subscription the item relates to, if any.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount in minor currency units. Negative for credits.

columns.name: proration
columns.description: Whether the item is a proration adjustment.

invoice_payments.description: Payment attempts against an invoice, linking invoices to the charges or payment intents that settled them.
invoice_payments.grain: One row per payment applied to an invoice.

columns.name: amount_paid
columns.description: Amount applied, in minor currency units.

notes: Use this rather than invoices.charge_id when an invoice can be settled by multiple payments.

invoice_line_item_tax_amounts.description: Tax amounts applied to individual invoice line items.
invoice_line_item_tax_amounts.grain: One row per (invoice line item, tax rate).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Tax amount in minor currency units.

invoice_line_item_discount_amounts.description: Discount amounts applied to individual invoice line items.
invoice_line_item_discount_amounts.grain: One row per (invoice line item, discount).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Discount amount in minor currency units.

notes: Sum amount grouped by invoice_id to get total discount per invoice.

invoice_custom_fields.description: Custom key/value fields rendered on an invoice.

invoice_customer_tax_ids.description: Customer tax identifiers captured on an invoice.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice the tax id appears on.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Tax id type, e.g. eu_vat, us_ein.

invoice_shipping_cost_taxes.description: Tax applied to shipping costs on an invoice.
invoice_shipping_cost_taxes.grain: One row per (invoice, shipping tax rate).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Tax amount in minor currency units.

tax_rates.description: Manually defined tax rates used on invoices and subscriptions. Distinct from Stripe Tax's automatic calculations.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Name shown to customers, e.g. VAT.

columns.name: inclusive
columns.description: Whether the rate is included in the price.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the rate can still be applied.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Two-letter ISO country the rate applies to.

plans.description: Legacy recurring pricing objects, superseded by prices. Retained for older integrations.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount per interval in minor currency units.

columns.name: interval
columns.description: Billing interval. `interval` is a reserved word in Trino — quote it as "interval".

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the plan is still usable.

notes: Prefer prices for new work. `interval` must be quoted in Trino.

columns.name: unit_amount
columns.description: Amount in that currency's minor units.

columns.name: amount_off
columns.description: Fixed discount in that currency's minor units.

quotes.description: Sales quotes that can be accepted to create an invoice or subscription.

columns.name: amount_total
columns.description: Quote total in minor currency units.

subscription_schedules.description: Planned sequences of subscription phases, used for scheduled price or term changes.

subscription_schedule_phases.description: Individual phases of a subscription schedule.

subscription_schedule_phase_configuratio.description: Priced items configured within a subscription schedule phase.
subscription_schedule_phase_configuratio.grain: One row per item in a phase.

subscription_schedule_phase_add_invoice_.description: One-off invoice items attached to a subscription schedule phase.
subscription_schedule_phase_add_invoice_.grain: One row per add-invoice-item in a phase.

subscription_item_change_events_v2_beta.description: Public preview rebuild of subscription_item_change_events with 3-hour freshness instead of 24-hour. Same columns.
subscription_item_change_events_v2_beta.grain: One row per MRR-moving change to a subscription item.
notes: Preview table — Stripe may change it. Prefer subscription_item_change_events unless you need the fresher data.

subscription_item_change_events_testmode.grain: One row per MRR-moving change to a test-mode subscription item.

usage_records.description: Reported usage quantities for metered subscription items. Legacy path; newer integrations use billing meters.

columns.name: subscription_item_id
columns.description: Metered subscription item the usage applies to.

recoveries.description: Smart Retries and dunning outcomes — revenue recovered after a failed subscription payment.
recoveries.grain: One row per recovery attempt or recovered invoice.
notes: The table to use for involuntary churn and dunning effectiveness reporting.

customer_balance_transactions.description: Changes to a customer's account credit balance.
customer_balance_transactions.grain: One row per customer balance transaction.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Signed change in minor currency units.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice the change relates to, if any.

customer_cash_balance_transactions.description: Changes to a customer's cash balance held at Stripe, used for bank-transfer funding.
customer_cash_balance_transactions.grain: One row per cash balance transaction.

columns.name: net_amount
columns.description: Signed change in minor currency units.

customer_tax_ids.description: Tax identifiers stored against a customer.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer the tax id belongs to.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Tax id type, e.g. eu_vat, us_ein.

issuing_disputes.description: Disputes you filed on behalf of cardholders against merchants.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Disputed amount in minor currency units.

issuing_network_tokens.description: Network tokens provisioned for issued cards, such as those created when a card is added to a mobile wallet.

transfer_reversals.description: Reversals of manually created transfers or payouts. Automatic payouts cannot be reversed.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Reversed amount in minor currency units.

treasury_financial_accounts.description: Treasury financial accounts that store funds for your platform's users.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Two-letter ISO country of the account.

treasury_transactions.description: Ledger of all money movement on Treasury financial accounts.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Signed amount in minor currency units.

treasury_transaction_entries.description: Individual ledger entries making up a Treasury transaction.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Signed amount in minor currency units.

treasury_inbound_transfers.description: Money pulled into a Treasury financial account from an external bank account.

treasury_outbound_transfers.description: Money sent from a Treasury financial account to an external bank account you own.

treasury_outbound_payments.description: Money sent from a Treasury financial account to a third party.

terminal_locations.description: Physical locations where you operate Terminal card readers.

columns.name: address_country
columns.description: Two-letter ISO country of the location.

terminal_readers.description: Terminal card reader devices registered to your account.

columns.name: location_id
columns.description: Location the reader is assigned to.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Whether the reader is online or offline.

terminal_hardware_orders.description: Orders you placed for Terminal reader hardware.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Order total in minor currency units.

terminal_hardware_order_items.description: Line items on a Terminal hardware order.
terminal_hardware_order_items.grain: One row per item on an order.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Line amount in minor currency units.

terminal_hardware_order_tax_amounts.description: Tax applied to a Terminal hardware order.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Tax amount in minor currency units.

terminal_hardware_order_shipment_trackin.description: Shipment tracking information for Terminal hardware orders.
terminal_hardware_order_shipment_trackin.grain: One row per shipment tracking record.

financing_offers.description: Stripe Capital financing offers extended to you or your connected accounts.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Account the offer was made to.

financing_balances.description: Outstanding Stripe Capital loan balances over time.

financing_transactions.description: Repayments and drawdowns against Stripe Capital financing.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Signed amount in minor currency units.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Whether this is a drawdown or a repayment.

summarized_balance_transactions.description: Pre-aggregated balance transaction totals, grouped by period and reporting category. Much cheaper than aggregating balance_transactions yourself.
summarized_balance_transactions.grain: One row per (period, currency, reporting category).
notes: Use this for high-level financial summaries; drop to balance_transactions only when you need row-level detail.

connected_account_summarized_balance_tra.description: Connect platform view of summarized_balance_transactions, per connected account.
connected_account_summarized_balance_tra.grain: One row per (connected account, period, currency, reporting category).

connected_account_itemized_fees.description: Connect platform view of itemized_fees, showing fees paid by each connected account.
connected_account_itemized_fees.grain: One row per fee, per connected account.
notes: amount and tax are in MAJOR currency units, same as itemized_fees.

connected_account_itemized_fees_beta.grain: One row per fee, per connected account.

activity_report_itemized.description: Itemized activity report backing Stripe's Dashboard reporting, one row per balance-affecting event with reporting classifications.
activity_report_itemized.grain: One row per reportable activity item.
notes: Aligns with Stripe's Reporting exports rather than the raw API objects.

connected_account_activity_report_itemiz.description: Connect platform view of activity_report_itemized, per connected account.
connected_account_activity_report_itemiz.grain: One row per reportable activity item, per connected account.

acceptance_reporting_v3_itemized.description: Itemized payment acceptance reporting: authorization attempts with decline and retry classification.

analytics_acceptance_itemized.description: Itemized acceptance analytics used by Stripe's authorization rate reporting.
analytics_acceptance_itemized.grain: One row per acceptance analytics record.

aggregate_optimization_details.description: Aggregated view of Stripe's payment optimizations (such as Adaptive Acceptance) and their measured impact.
aggregate_optimization_details.grain: One row per aggregation window and optimization type.

charge_optimization_details.description: Per-charge record of which Stripe payment optimizations were applied and what they recovered.
charge_optimization_details.grain: One row per charge that had an optimization applied.

charge_groups.description: Groupings that link related charges, such as a retried payment and its original attempt.

cau_fees.description: Card Account Updater fees, charged when Stripe automatically refreshes stored card credentials.

network_cost_insights_report.description: Breakdown of interchange and scheme network costs underlying your processing fees.
network_cost_insights_report.grain: One row per network cost line.

revenue_recognition_debits_and_credits.description: Double-entry debits and credits produced by Stripe Revenue Recognition, for building deferred revenue and recognized revenue schedules.
notes: Pairs with Stripe's Revenue Recognition reports; see docs.stripe.com/revenue-recognition/reports/sigma-and-sdp.

tax_forms.description: Tax forms (such as 1099s) generated for your connected accounts.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Connected account the form was issued for.

crypto_onramp_sessions.description: Stripe crypto onramp sessions where users bought crypto with fiat.
